description:
As far back as 2003, Kanye had planned a four-album series revolving around going to college, with Good Ass Job concluding the series. The death of his mother derailed this plan, with his fourth album becoming the somber 808s & Heartbreak. People still expected Good Ass Job to release, though, as Kanye's next album as late as early 2010. When the wake of the 2009 VMAs incident happened, it would cause Good Ass Job not to release. Kanye would take to twitter on July 27th, 2010, tweeting that the album was "no longer called Good Ass Job" and that he was "bouncing a couple ideas". The art used for this era is the original cover for the single "POWER."

(11/24/2008) (808s & Heartbreak officially releases)
(07/28/2010) (Kanye tweets that the album is no longer called Good Ass Job)
